description: Retirement is paused since 2026-08-04. While it is paused this tool answers RETIREMENT_PAUSED and names no payable door, and the paid door refuses before any charge. When the lane runs, this tool says how to retire a given tCO2e amount on-chain via the Klima rail, paid from the caller's own wallet, returning a confirmed retire transaction as the certificate. It returns instructions and the exact door; this server never performs the retirement and never holds a wallet. Any footprint number behind a retirement stays orientation, never a precise carbon claim. Cost and signer: this read is free and keyless; the retirement itself is paid and signed by the caller's own wallet.

amount_tco2e.description: Tonnes of CO2e to retire, e.g. 0.005.

beneficiary_name.description: Optional name to record on the retirement.

retirement_message.description: Optional message to record on the retirement.

name: retire_and_certify
title: Retire carbon on-chain and get the certificate
